description: Look up up to 50 products at once by SKU or by numeric id. Returns compact products (name, price ex/inc VAT, stock, link).

locale.description: Storefront locale such as en-GB (default), en-US, de, fr-FR, es-ES, it-IT, nl-NL, pl. Controls product names, slugs and prices.

items.description: Product SKU exactly as shown on the site.

name: get_products

categories.description: Up to 8 category names; get_product has the product's details.

express_eligible.description: Website Express (same-working-day UK dispatch); only when the listing reports it.

bulk_prices.description: Lower unit prices from min_quantity up.

vat_rate.description: VAT rate in percent (20 = 20%). null when unknown: ex_vat then equals inc_vat.

was_inc_vat.description: Price before the sale; only when on_sale.

price.description: null when the product has no online price.

title: Get several products
